evals.prompt: Faz um re-review do backend do AssinAi desde a primeira revisão de design, e me mostra se a nota melhorou. O código atual é o da branch stage.
evals.expected_output: A lens re-review with a status for every baseline finding backed by current code, new findings from the changed code, baseline and current grades per aspect, and a computed before/after comparison.
assertions: Every baseline finding of the lens has exactly one status, with evidence from the current code
No finding is marked Fixed on the strength of a closed issue or merged PR alone
The current scorecard grades every numbered check of the lens and passes the cap checks
Baseline grades are taken from the baseline scorecard, or labelled reconstructed when it has none
scripts/compare.py exits zero and its comparison appears unchanged in the merged report
New findings or regressions in the changed code are listed, or the lens states it found none
The report names the baseline commit and the current commit it compared

evals.prompt: we closed most of the security issues from last month's audit. can you check what's actually still open and give me a before/after score?
evals.expected_output: A security-lens re-review that verifies fixes in code rather than trusting closed issues, and a partial before/after score labelled as security only.
assertions: Only the security lens runs, and the score is labelled partial
Findings whose issue is closed but whose defect is still in the code are reported as Open or Partially fixed
